item.title: Senate Hearing Examines Impact of FCC Broadcast Ownership Rule on Local Journalism, Market Competition
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. - In a Senate Commerce hearing, Senators looked at the changes to the American media landscape, focusing on a rule on broadcast ownership. The hearing comes at a time where a major broadcast group is looking to solidify a deal that could allow their broadcast company to reach 80 percent of TV households. Broadcasters shared the pros and cons of how changing that FCC rule could impact local journalism.

item.title: MSP investigating Garden Township house explosion
item.description: The homeowners were not home at the time of the explosion, and no injuries were reported by anyone else. Several neighboring homes sustained damage because of the explosion.

item.title: Trump campaign defends bridge concerns as Michigan Democrats warn of economic impact
item.description: Michigan Democrats and the Trump campaign are sparring over the Gordie Howe International Bridge as new reporting highlights lobbying tied to a competing crossing. The dispute centers on trade, ownership and economic control of the project.
